name: ai-kit
description: General software-development-lifecycle kit with a project-rules setup flow and rules gate. Claude Code is the source of truth; Codex shares the same skills and hooks.

interface.shortDescription: SDLC workflow + project rules for every repo.
interface.longDescription: Ticket to PR workflow skills (plan, TDD, test, debug, review, PR) plus a first-run setup that writes workspace and repository rules (AGENTS.md) and a gate that loads them before code changes.
defaultPrompt: Create rules for this project, a repository, a folder or all my projects.
Plan and implement this ticket test-first.
